knowledge.title: Opening hours
knowledge.content: Northstar Heating is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 14:00.

knowledge.title: Service area
knowledge.content: We serve South London and nearby areas, including SE19, SE20, SE21, CR0 and BR3.

knowledge.title: Services
knowledge.content: Approved services are annual boiler servicing, boiler repairs, heating diagnostics, radiator balancing and smart thermostat installation.

knowledge.title: Pricing
knowledge.content: A standard annual boiler service starts from £95. Repair pricing depends on diagnosis; the team confirms any charge before work begins.

knowledge.title: Payment
knowledge.content: We accept major debit and credit cards and bank transfer. Payment is due after completed work unless agreed otherwise.

knowledge.title: Guarantee
knowledge.content: Completed repair work includes a 12-month workmanship guarantee. Manufacturer warranties remain subject to their own terms.

knowledge.content: Call Hoxtans on 020 3325 6208 or email hoxtans@gmail.com. Call to confirm today's opening hours and availability.

knowledge.title: Tanning services
knowledge.content: Hoxtans offers full-body spray tans, express spray tans, sunbed sessions and courses, plus tanning preparation and aftercare advice.

knowledge.title: Beauty treatments

knowledge.title: Appointments and walk-ins
knowledge.content: Walk-ins are welcome when availability permits. Customers should call ahead to check availability. Evening appointments may be available.
